notes: Investigating an anomaly now costs food, not wisdom — you can do it from a fresh map, before you have a temple.
The ground can hold an anomaly now — strange cells you investigate for a hidden reward, or a short branching story.
A History log of everything you have done, opened from the claim line or the menu. Each entry links to the codex.
A codex: turn Vigil on and a blue link explains it; the log links into ten more entries.
Fog of war — the map only shows the ground you hold and the ring around it, with a small terrain glyph on each.
The Hearth cannot be lost: it never decays and never changes hands.
A hamburger menu at the top holds sound, vibration, Retreat and Delete; the walking bar keeps only Here and Vigil.
A claim plays a chime and a buzz, switchable off. Ground taken from a rival gets a fuller sound.
The Keep opens the nation panel. Härmälä has hand-surveyed terrain around the test area.
Ground two players both hold splits its yield by who has walked it more.
Phase 2.5: the Hearth, adjacency growth, dwell, terrain, warding, and the Wager by hand.
Buildings, a technology tree, mana from temples, spells, and dark times.
Walk a closed loop, claim the land inside it. GPS tracking, the ley-line, loop detection, H3 cells, capture, reinforcement and decay.
